meta.evidence_window: engine days 2001-2040 compared with the earlier system's day titling for the same dates (evidence of naming only)

rules.basis: The reviewed Armenian and English titles of the earlier system replace the titles derived directly from the two Hador books for display; the book heading is kept as book_heading.

A Hador 1 record that names one commemoration is linked to the reviewed title by name evidence and by the earlier system's own titling of the same days; every link carries match_basis and a status; ambiguous links are needs_human_review.
Generic days (numbered days, Sundays, fast days, Barekendan) are titled from the engine's own day facts: an engine anchor plus a day offset, or the n-th Sunday after the octave of the Nativity.
A Wednesday or Friday fast day that belongs to no numbered series takes the reviewed 'Fast of Wednesday/Friday' title.
When the engine places the standard commemorations of a registered combination on one day, the day is named by the reviewed combined title and the change is 'substantial'.

Every April 24 carries the label 'Remembrance of the Holy Martyrs of the Armenian Genocide' in addition to the day's own commemoration; no special readings; all other variables come from the primary feast.
